summary: ```# Overview of New Features in Marvelous Designer 2024 ## Introduction Marvelous Designer 2024 introduces a variety of new features aimed at enhancing the user experience and expanding creative possibilities. This document outlines the key functionalities available in the latest version. ## Multiple Wind Control Devices From the Marvelous Designer 2024 version, you can turn on multiple wind control devices. Through this function, you can create a more diversified wind-blowing environment. 1. **Activating Wind Control Devices**: - Go to the display environment icon in the 3D window. - Click to display the wind control device. 2. **Copying Wind Control Devices**: - Right-click on the wind control device icon and select "Copy." - Adjust the position of the copied wind control device, rotate, and set the value according to your needs. 3. **Animation and Effects**: - After setting, record the animation and check the effect. - Through multiple wind control devices, we simulated the animation effect of the jellyfish floating. 4. **Wireless Border Settings**: - When creating a wind control device, open the wireless border to make it blow wind at an unlimited range. - If you close the wireless border, the wind-blowing effect will only work within the range marked by the wind control device. - You can manually release the wind-blowing function. ## Video Capture Function The video capture function allows you to quickly capture the animation played in the 3D window and save it as a video. 1. **Accessing Video Capture Tool**: - You can find the video capture tool in the animation video capture or in the animation editor on the main menu. 2. **Setting Up Video Capture**: - First, go to the animation editor settings to set the animation playback area. - Click the video capture button and then click "Capture" to start the process. 3. **Stopping Video Capture**: - After opening the video capture button, it will turn into a stop button. - You can stop the video capture at any time. 4. **Playback of Recorded Video**: - After the recording is over, the video will be automatically played in the default playback software. ## Software Model Simulation The software model simulation function provides a more realistic display of the model's skin tone. 1. **Default Virtual Model**: - Currently, only the default virtual model of Marvelous Designer is supported. - For custom virtual models, you will need to use the automatic virtual model function. 2. **Activating Software Model Simulation**: - Select the virtual model in the 3D window and go to the property editor to see the software model simulation. - Set the software model intensity; the smaller the value, the softer the skin. 3. **Simulation Activation Icon**: - When activating the software model simulation, an icon will appear in the lower right corner of the 3D window to indicate activation. - After opening the model simulation, you will see that the skin is entangled by the bandage and slightly concave. 4. **Recording with Software Model Simulation**: - When the software model simulation is turned on, it will be recorded as a separate animation layer that can be exported to the Alembic format. ## Automatic Virtual Model Simulation Through the automatic virtual model simulation function, you can convert virtual models created in other software into the default virtual model in Marvelous Designer. 1. **Importing Models**: - Click on the main menu, then virtual model, and select automatic virtual model simulation. - Open an AVT, OBJ, or FBX file in the window. 2. **Selecting Default Virtual Model**: - Choose the appropriate default virtual model according to gender and age. - In the conversion option, you can choose to automate or self-define. 3. **Maintaining Body Shape**: - The MD skin type will maintain the body shape of the original model while converting the neck appearance to that of the default virtual model. - The size and editing options will change the body shape of the model, increasing joint points for better functionality. 4. **Viewing Converted Models**: - After clicking on conversion, you will see the virtual models generated by your image in the 3D window. - Now your virtual model has been converted and can utilize Marvelous Designer's default virtual model features, such as software model simulation. ## Everywhere Function The Everywhere function allows creators to connect digital costumes to all virtual models and digital spaces. 1. **Optimizing Digital Costumes**: - Creators can easily optimize the digital costumes made for various digital spaces in Marvelous Designer. - For example, this includes webpage optimization, UV fill, and logic preparation. 2. **Setting Optimization Goals**: - Set your goal for the total number of web pages according to your needs. - Click on the optimization button to optimize your costume web page based on the input value. 3. **Optimizing Attached or Buttoned Web Pages**: - For optimization of attached or buttoned web pages, select the attached option or navigate to the physical window to select the type of button. - Use the attribute editor to select the bottom multi-sided web page optimization function and enter the target web page number. 4. **Plane and Four-Sided Options**: - Selecting "plane" will transform it into a plane and display it as a sticker. - For a four-sided web page, select the middle version in the attribute editor and choose the four-sided optimization option from the drop-down menu. ## Google Binding The Google binding feature allows for the automatic binding of costumes to Google. 1. **Binding Process**: - Click on the application button of the Google app under the costume label. - An update and brush button will appear; click on the brush button to switch to the brush window for adjustments. 2. **Adjusting Joint Points**: - Press the Ctrl key to click on a joint point to see the related weight. - You can place the weight in the 2D or 3D window and use the brush to increase, decrease, and smooth the weight. 3. **Moving and Rotating Joints**: - Use Shift + X to move or rotate the joint and load the posture to check if the costume correctly follows the bone or if there are any penetrating parts. 4. **Sculpting Adjustments**: - If you find holes or intersections in the costume, you can use the sculpt brush for adjustments. - There are two mixing modes available: Grinding and Smooth, which can be toggled by pressing Ctrl + Tab. ## UV Fill and Vanity Cookedback The UV fill function helps to automatically fill the UV block to prevent overlap and arrange UV pictures efficiently. 1. **Using UV Fill**: - In the UV Fill window, enter all the numbers and click on "Use." - This helps to prevent overlap and quickly arrange the UV picture. 2. **Vanity Cookedback Function**: - In the vanity cookedback window, choose the Macro loan sticker and the environmental light folding sticker options. - Adjust the strength of the hairline sticker by clicking the slider. 3. **Uploading Files**: - When ready to upload the file to the Connect page, click the upload button in the Everywhere window. - After setting up your selection, click "OK" to complete the upload. 4. **FBX Download**: - Click the FBX download button to download the FBX file. ## Live Sync Feature Live Sync is a feature that connects Marvelous Designer to the virtual machine. 1. **Direct Import and Export**: - Through this feature, Marvelous Designer can directly import and export files to the virtual machine. - In the virtual machine, go to the CloudAMD Live Sync Editor window and click the update button to import the costume and the new model. 2. **Saving Assets**: - Once confirmed, save the downloaded assets to the virtual machine's content browser by selecting "assets" and clicking "Save Marker." - Choose between static grid or integrated grid stored by animation, and click "Save Marker." 3. **Viewing Assets**: - The assets can then be viewed in the content browser. 4. **Importing MetalHuman**: - You can also import MetalHuman to Marvelous Designer through Live Sync. ## Sewing Wrinkle Function The sewing wrinkle function enhances the detail of outfits by creating sewing wrinkles along the outside, inside, and sewing lines. 1. **Creating Sewing Wrinkles**: - Use the sewing wrinkle tool group in the 2D window to create and adjust the sewing wrinkle. - There are three methods to create sewing wrinkles: line creation, free creation, and sewing line creation. 2. **Viewing Effects**: - After creating the sewing wrinkle in the 2D window, you can see the effect on the 3D costume. 3. **Customizing Sewing Wrinkles**: - Switch the object window to Pugrin, which is the sewing wrinkle type window, and select a sewing wrinkle type. - Use the attribute editor to switch the preset type of sewing wrinkle or customize the style according to your needs. 4. **Loading Custom Sewing Wrinkles**: - You can load custom sewing wrinkles and use them as a pattern or hair sticker for the sewing wrinkle. ## Conclusion Marvelous Designer 2024 presents an array of powerful features designed to enhance the workflow and creative capabilities of its users. From improved wind control to sophisticated model simulations and binding capabilities, these updates provide significant advantages for digital fashion creators
